Name: Nyapu-Style Cornucopia Cooking Recipes
Author: nugmods
Description:
Nyapu-Style Portraits for the Mysterious Lady from Cornucopia Cooking Recipes! Who could she be...? We just don't know.

This is a Content Patcher mod, so all you need to do is drag and drop it into your mods folder. It will automatically patch the portraits from Cornucopia with the new style.
